item.title: AAA Devs HUMILIATED After Hollow Knight: Silksong Shatters Records With Over Half A Million Players On Day One
item.description: When a bug can topple giants, you know something’s up. Hollow Knight: Silksong, the long-awaited sequel from indie studio Team Cherry, finally arrived, and the internet promptly collapsed under the weight of millions of players hammering “download.
